lines.text: Samson goes to Gaza, leaves at midnight, and carries the city gate doors to a mountain overlooking Hebron.
Samson loves Delilah of the Valley of Sorek, and the Philistine lords each offer her eleven hundred shekels of silver.
Delilah ties Samson with seven fresh bowstrings, but he snaps them like a strand of yarn.
Delilah ties Samson with new ropes and then weaves his seven braids into a loom, but he breaks free both times.
Samson tells Delilah his hair was never cut, so she has it shaved, and the Philistines blind him and take him to Hebron.
